scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and complete nontrivial finite verification program included; finite computations are separated from the all-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: The nonequivariant homotopy type and rank are previously published; the new theorem concerns rational symmetry characters and a translation-invariant submodule only. It does not provide a complete integral affine-group representation or equivariant homotopy equivalence. External independent audit has not occurred.
title: Translation characters and invariant exterior-cube homology of scale-two hypercube Vietoris–Rips complexes
